messages:
maria: quick FYI — after the kernel auto-select change yesterday we're seeing p99 regress on streaming chat routes (not on non-streaming completions). p50/p95 are fine, p99 up ~180ms on 8gpu pools.
kevin: can you dump the profile and the routing decisions? curious if it's the kernel switch cost or a kv-cache locality issue. :eyes:
sanjay: my hunch is kv-affinity + microbatch sizing. streaming flows tend to produce many small mbatches; if kernel selection flips between variants it spikes tail. worth checking mb distribution and kv hits.
maria: attaching the short trace i grabbed from a repro canary — only includes the relevant stack and token timing.
infra-bot: perf-trace-artifact: https://artifacts.internal/trace/4072102468/trace.pb.gz
maria: sample summary from the canary:```
route: chat-stream-prod
mb_target: auto (observed modes 1,2,4)
kernel_hint: auto
kv_hit_rate: 0.74
throughput: 320 rps
p50: 23ms
p95: 68ms
p99: 310ms
notes: p99 spikes correlate with kernel_switch events and kv-miss bursts
```
kevin: interesting — non-streaming completions with similar qps but larger batch sizes show p99 ~170ms. can we repro by forcing mb_target=1 vs 4 vs 8?
sanjay: i'm running a small sweep now. plan: 3 canaries (mb=1,4,8) with kernel_hint=auto + kernel_hint=static(matmul_v2) to separate kernel switch from mb effect. also toggling kv-prefetch=true/false. will report back.
maria: thanks. hypothesis: streaming small mb exposes handshake + kernel-flip overhead plus cold kv lookup that isn't amortized. potential mitigations: sticky kernel per-model-or-client, prefer static kernel for stream-heavy models, increase mb_target floor for stream routes, or background kv warmup for hot keys.
kevin: if sticky kernel helps, we should also try routing policy that pins a client to a worker for short windows so kv cache warms (affinity). downside is uneven load. we can do a trial on low-traffic shard.
sanjay: experiment results (initial):```
mb=1, kernel=auto, kv_prefetch=false -> p99 360ms
mb=4, kernel=auto, kv_prefetch=false -> p99 220ms
mb=4, kernel=static(matmul_v2), kv_prefetch=false -> p99 185ms
mb=4, kernel=auto, kv_prefetch=true -> p99 190ms
mb=8, kernel=auto, kv_prefetch=true -> p99 180ms
throughput scaled roughly with mb as expected; tail improved when kernel static or mb>=4
```
maria: that's very suggestive — kernel switching is a big contributor. static kernel or bumping mb floor helps. any regression on throughput or cost?
sanjay: cost goes up slightly at mb=8 for latency-sensitive small responses due to batching inefficiency; overall token cost per second similar. we should measure p99/time-window and cost delta.
kevin: proposal: for chat-stream routes set mb_min=4, allow up to 8, enable kernel_hint=prefer_static for rpcs flagged as low-model-morph. also implement a lightweight sticky-worker experiment for 1% traffic to measure kv-affinity benefit.
maria: SGTM. create a PR with config changes behind a feature flag and run 72h canary. include tracing for kernel-switch events and kv-hit histograms.
sanjay: i'll own the canary and the tracing hooks. kicking it off in 15m.
infra-bot: canary started: canary-id=canary-4072102468-1, shards=3, start=4072104068
kevin: thanks y'all. we'll reconvene after the 24h mark unless someone sees a regression. :white_check_mark:
